method.harness: OfflineAudioContext; actual FX classes imported from src/audio/fx
method.threshold: first sample with abs(amplitude) >= 1e-4 * whole-render peak
method.cpuTimeDefinition: wall-clock time spent awaiting OfflineAudioContext.startRendering(); not realtime/device latency
method.liveCompressorCapture: AudioContext at 48 kHz, sample capture in a second AudioWorklet tap, synthetic AudioBufferSourceNode, output set to sinkId none or a private MediaStreamDestination; no getUserMedia/enumerateDevices calls

compressorDiagnostics.source: OfflineAudioContext with the actual CompressorFX class; synthetic stereo input; no device streams

compressorRealtimeDiagnostics.mode: AudioContext realtime AudioWorklet with synthetic AudioBufferSourceNode input and a worklet sample capture tap; no media devices
